label: Pegasus 间谍软件曝光（2021）
description: 2021年7月18日，法国非营利组织 Forbidden Stories 与国际特赦组织牵头、17家媒体组成的“Pegasus Project”同时发布调查，揭露 NSO 集团间谍软件被多国政府用于监控记者、活动人士与政要。首发为法国机构，随后 The Guardian、Washington Post、Le Monde、Süddeutsche Zeitung、Haaretz、El País 等协作媒体同步发布，中文媒体随后跟进。标注依据为 Pegasus Project 公开发布时间线（2021-07-18）。本案例含法语-英语跨语言同事件报道对。

articles.title: The Pegasus Project: leaked list reveals targets of NSO spyware
articles.content: A consortium of news organizations coordinated by Forbidden Stories has obtained a leaked list of 50,000 phone numbers believed to be potential targets of NSO Group's Pegasus spyware. The numbers include journalists, human rights activists and heads of state. NSO denies the list is connected to its surveillance operations.

articles.title: Revealed: leak uncovers global abuse of cyber-surveillance weapon
articles.content: Human rights activists, journalists and lawyers across the world have been targeted by authoritarian governments using hacking software sold by the Israeli surveillance company NSO Group, according to an investigation by the Guardian and 16 other media organizations. The leak contains a list of more than 50,000 phone numbers.

articles.title: Projet Pegasus : des logiciels espions au service d'États autoritaires
articles.content: Une enquête menée par un consortium de dix-sept médias révèle que le logiciel espion Pegasus, vendu par la société israélienne NSO, a été utilisé pour cibler des journalistes, des opposants et des chefs d'État. Une liste de 50 000 numéros de téléphone a été obtenue par Forbidden Stories et Amnesty International.

articles.title: Private Israeli spyware used to hack cellphones of journalists, activists worldwide
articles.content: Military-grade spyware licensed by the Israeli firm NSO Group has been used in attempted and successful hacks of 37 smartphones belonging to journalists, human rights activists and business executives, an investigation by The Washington Post and its partners found. The phones appeared on a list of more than 50,000 numbers.

articles.title: Pegasus-Projekt: Staaten spähen Journalisten mit Spähsoftware aus
articles.content: Ein internationales Recherchebündnis hat aufgedeckt, dass die israelische Spähsoftware Pegasus offenbar weltweit gegen Journalisten, Aktivisten und Politiker eingesetzt wurde. Auf einer Liste mit 50 000 Telefonnummern stehen auch Nummern von Staatsoberhäuptern. Die NSO Group weist die Vorwürfe zurück.

articles.title: NSO's Pegasus spyware: global investigation exposes Israeli firm's client abuse
articles.content: A global investigation has exposed how clients of the Israeli cyber-intelligence firm NSO Group used its Pegasus spyware to target journalists and dissidents around the world. The revelations have triggered calls in Israel for tighter oversight of cyber exports. NSO maintains its technology is licensed only to vetted governments to fight terrorism.

articles.title: Proyecto Pegasus: el espionaje masivo con software israelí salta a escena global
articles.content: Una investigación de diecisiete medios internacionales revela que el software espía Pegasus, de la empresa israelí NSO, fue empleado para vigilar a periodistas, activistas y dirigentes políticos. La lista filtrada contiene 50 000 números de teléfono de todo el mundo. Entre los números aparecen también los de políticos españoles.

articles.title: “飞马”间谍软件丑闻曝光 多国政要记者疑遭监听
articles.content: 多家国际媒体联合调查披露，以色列NSO集团开发的“飞马”间谍软件被多国用于监听记者、人权活动人士和政界人士。报道称，一份包含5万个电话号码的潜在监控名单被曝光。NSO集团否认相关指控，称其软件仅用于打击恐怖主义和严重犯罪。

articles.title: Tour de France: Pogacar seals second consecutive title
articles.content: Tadej Pogacar secured his second consecutive Tour de France victory on Sunday after the final stage on the Champs-Élysées. The 22-year-old Slovenian finished more than five minutes ahead of his nearest rival. Organizers said next year's race will start in Denmark.

articles.title: 国家医保药品目录调整工作启动
articles.content: 国家医保局本周启动2021年国家医保药品目录调整工作。根据方案，一批临床价值高、患者负担重的创新药有望纳入报销范围。企业申报工作将于下月截止。
